title: purchase.booked payload
description: kaikei -> Dreamshop: the source event was booked in e-conomic. Exactly one of obligation_id and receipt_id: receipt_id when source_event_type is purchase.goods_received, obligation_id otherwise (validator, tier 3). supplier_number is required for the document events (P, F, K); Dreamshop stores it on the supplier when that field is empty. voucher_number and accounting_year are required, and entries must not be empty, unless source_event_type is purchase.prepayment_paid: a prepayment payment with no VAT to repost is settled without booking, answered without a voucher and with entries: [] (validator, tier 3, since 1.18.0).

client_id.description: The kaikei client (one kaikei deployment = one client = one e-conomic agreement). Carried in data because the envelope has additionalProperties:false. The receiver rejects a foreign client with klient_forkert.

voucher_number.description: The e-conomic voucher number. Absent only when a purchase.prepayment_paid was settled without booking.

accounting_year.description: The e-conomic accounting year, as e-conomic names it (e.g. 2026 or 2025/2026). Absent only when a purchase.prepayment_paid was settled without booking.

supplier_number.description: The e-conomic supplier the voucher was booked on.

entries.description: The voucher's entries. Empty only when a purchase.prepayment_paid was settled without booking.

amount.description: Signed: positive is debit, negative is credit.
